reason: A DeepSeek Harness text-to-speech plugin that reads assistant replies aloud using Edge TTS or an optional local RVC voice-conversion service, with playback controls, settings, streaming, and audio download support.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音朗读功能，支持 Edge TTS 和可选的本地 RVC 自定义音色，并提供自动朗读、播放控制与音频下载。
summaries.en: Adds text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness using Edge TTS or an optional local RVC voice service, with auto-read, playback controls, and audio downloads.

capabilities: Synthesizes assistant text into speech through the Edge TTS service
Supports playback controls, automatic reading, selected-text reading, and audio downloads
Can invoke a locally running RVC service for custom voice conversion
Stores voice and playback preferences in browser localStorage and writes synthesized audio to the OS temporary directory
